name: Underwood Family Farms Moorpark (Tierra Rejada)
tagline: Pick Your Own – Underwood Family Farms
description: In Moorpark, CA, Underwood Family Farms Moorpark (Tierra Rejada) raises Strawberries and Tomatoes on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
